primary_responsibility: Manages the lifecycle of user subscriptions, including creation, cancellation, renewal, and integration with external payment providers.

functional_group_candidates.name: Subscription Lifecycle Management
functional_group_candidates.user_goal: Manage the full lifecycle of a SaaS subscription from creation to cancellation
business_rules: User cannot have more than one active subscription
Subscription plan must be available to be selected
Paid plans require successful Stripe subscription creation before activation
Billing dates are calculated based on plan interval (monthly, yearly, weekly)
Features are granted upon activation and revoked upon immediate cancellation
Failed payments transition subscription status to past_due

functional_group_candidates.name: Billing and Payment Processing
functional_group_candidates.user_goal: Process payments and handle billing cycles for paid subscriptions
business_rules: Renewal requires successful payment for paid plans
Usage records must be created upon successful billing/renewal
Next billing date must be updated upon successful renewal
Users must be notified of confirmations, renewals, and payment failures
